title: Laser-propelled flying-disc tests at Sandia and White Sands
place_text: Sandia National Lab and White Sands, New Mexico

plain: At Sandia National Lab, a government weapons laboratory in New Mexico, and at the White Sands military test range nearby, someone tested a disc that was pushed through the air by a laser beam. Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the NSA, tells Michels this, saying there is video of it and that he knows the man who did the work. He brings it up as an example of human technology that might be mistaken for a UFO.
